description: This file defines classes and functions for fetching and processing OECD country interest rates data, including query parameter validation, data extraction from OECD API, and data transformation.

classes.name: OecdCountryInterestRatesQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for OECD country interest rates, including validation for country codes and options for frequency and duration.

classes.name: OecdCountryInterestRatesData
classes.description: Data model for OECD country interest rates data.

classes.name: OecdCountryInterestRatesFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class that handles transforming queries, extracting data from OECD API, and transforming raw data into data models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a validated query object, setting default start and end dates if not provided.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Fetches data from OECD API, processes CSV response into a structured list of records.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data records into data model instances.

methods.name: validate_country
methods.description: Validates and processes country input, allowing multiple countries and handling invalid entries.
